notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for negotiated regular ownership-candidate continuation across a timed regional attribute update, federation save, federation restore, and post-restore delivery. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It covers standard region creation and metadata, timestamped attribute update and reflection, timed save and restore callbacks, ownership acquisition and negotiated divestiture, callback tags, Flush Queue delivery, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics. The immediate callback-model case remains an explicit candidate skip because synchronous delivery closes the negotiated continuation window before the first candidate resigns.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional subscription and registration, timestamped attribute update, timed save/restore, ownership acquisition and negotiated divestiture, time advance, Flush Queue, and standard FederateAmbassador delivery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management, DDM, time-management, save/restore, and ownership-management declarations
